events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years Since His Death
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas, dying six days later on September 13.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: 30 years ago, the music world lost a true icon. Tupac Shakur's influence continues to resonate. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: More than just a guitarist, Jimi Hendrix was a force of nature. Remembering the legend who changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. Which track still gets you every time?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher is 54 today. Still got it, still iconic. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Album Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon released his seminal solo album 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: The iPod: 25 Years Since Its Launch
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember your first iPod? 25 years ago, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. What was on your playlist?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic film franchise.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and which theme song is the ultimate?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Legendary songwriter and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend and Monty Python star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years of The White Album! So many tracks, so many memories. Which one is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Forever
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his presence, his legacy live on. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years of 'Rubber Soul'! The album that marked a new direction for The Beatles. Still a masterpiece.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the tragic loss of John Lennon at the age of 40.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: 46 years since the world fell silent for John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire. We remember him today.
